inputs: company/delegation_policy.yaml: seats, grants, budget ladder, autonomy, authority
company/org_registry.yaml and company/permissions.yaml, supplied by the caller
One AuthorityRequest: action, seat, department, risk, amount, implementer, reviewer
An ExceptionContext the caller fills from the job, review and gate it already holds
invariants: Shadow only: every decision and record refuses to claim authority to act, and mode=enforcing is refused at construction.
The reserved set is read from company/permissions.yaml, never restated; a grant naming a reserved action is refused at load.
Deployment authority is classified and granted to nobody; an unrecognised kind is CEO-reserved.
A seat never decides a request it raised, implemented or reviewed, and none may overrule an independent control.
Escalation stops at the lowest sufficient seat; a dormant, restricted or vacant seat decides nothing.
A subordinate grant may not exceed its escalation target on risk or budget; authority is granted, never taken.
An unknown budget ceiling escalates; sibling ceilings may not sum past their parent.
Money escalates through the CFO on a functional chain; no reporting line passes through it.
outputs: An AuthorityDecision: APPROVED, REJECTED or ESCALATE, with the chain it walked
An ExceptionReport naming why the CEO has to see this, empty for routine success
ManagementMetrics separating CEO decisions from CEO notifications
A DeploymentDecision saying what authority a deployment kind would need
A ShadowReport proving the canonical CEO stop semantics still hold
purpose: Calculates, in shadow, which seat may approve an action, whether separation of duties allows it, where it escalates, which exceptions the CEO must see, and what authority a deployment would need. It authorizes nothing.
risks: Nine of thirteen employees are dormant; most department paths collapse onto the COO.
Two new seats have decided nothing real; five replayed jobs are validation, not burn-in.
Deployment is modelled and granted to nobody; a policy is not activation.
Scenarios from branch reports, not read from a store.
title: Company executive delegation and separation of duties (shadow)
